data.summary_en: RobotAgentBench (RAB), using agent-assisted, human-in-the-loop real-to-sim pipeline, has 50 household layouts, 90 atomic tasks, 18 short-horizon tasks, 8 long-horizon tasks, and 4 open-ended scenarios, evaluating robot agents at multiple levels in unified framework, revealing a manipulation–autonomy gap and advantages of agentic architectures and recursive self-improvement.
